dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical linear narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward a pointed posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Visible convex deviation on the right lateral margin near the mid-section; otherwise smooth and continuous edges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey with a sharp, high-intensity specular highlight along the dorsal midline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of discrete, circular, light-grey patches located on the anterior and posterior dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the primary dark-grey pigmentation and the lighter circular patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct circular, light-pigmented spots (approximately 5-6) visible across the dorsal plane.
